{
  "candidate_rtl": "module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
    wire sub_ab;
    wire sub_ba;
    wire sub;
    wire [63:0] ax, bx;
    wire [63:0] p, g, h;
    wire [63:0] carry;
    wire [63:0] arithmetic_result;
    wire [15:0] gp0, gg0;
    wire [15:0] gp1, gg1;
    wire [15:0] gp2, gg2;
    wire [15:0] gp3, gg3;
    wire [15:0] gp4, gg4;

    assign sub_ab = (Oper == 3'b001);
    assign sub_ba = (Oper == 3'b010);
    assign sub = sub_ab | sub_ba;
    assign ax = a ^ {64{sub_ba}};
    assign bx = b ^ {64{sub_ab}};
    assign p = (a ^ b) ^ {64{sub}};
    assign g = ax & bx;

    // Absorb the subtraction carry-in into the lowest generate term.
    assign h[0] = g[0] | (p[0] & sub);
    assign h[63:1] = g[63:1];
    assign carry[0] = sub;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin: groups
            wire block_carry;
            assign gp0[k] = &p[4*k +: 4];
            assign gg0[k] = h[4*k+3]
                         | (p[4*k+3] & h[4*k+2])
                         | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & h[4*k+1])
                         | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & h[4*k]);

            if (k == 0) begin: first_group
                assign block_carry = 1'b0;
            end else begin: later_group
                assign block_carry = gg4[k-1];
                assign carry[4*k] = block_carry;
            end

            assign carry[4*k+1] = h[4*k]
                                  | (p[4*k] & block_carry);
            assign carry[4*k+2] = h[4*k+1]
                                  | (p[4*k+1] & h[4*k])
                                  | (p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & block_carry);
            assign carry[4*k+3] = h[4*k+2]
                                  | (p[4*k+2] & h[4*k+1])
                                  | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & h[4*k])
                                  | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & block_carry);
        end

        for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin: prefix
            if (k >= 1) begin: distance_1
                assign gg1[k] = gg0[k] | (gp0[k] & gg0[k-1]);
                assign gp1[k] = gp0[k] & gp0[k-1];
            end else begin: pass_1
                assign gg1[k] = gg0[k];
                assign gp1[k] = gp0[k];
            end
            if (k >= 2) begin: distance_2
                assign gg2[k] = gg1[k] | (gp1[k] & gg1[k-2]);
                assign gp2[k] = gp1[k] & gp1[k-2];
            end else begin: pass_2
                assign gg2[k] = gg1[k];
                assign gp2[k] = gp1[k];
            end
            if (k >= 4) begin: distance_4
                assign gg3[k] = gg2[k] | (gp2[k] & gg2[k-4]);
                assign gp3[k] = gp2[k] & gp2[k-4];
            end else begin: pass_4
                assign gg3[k] = gg2[k];
                assign gp3[k] = gp2[k];
            end
            if (k >= 8) begin: distance_8
                assign gg4[k] = gg3[k] | (gp3[k] & gg3[k-8]);
                assign gp4[k] = gp3[k] & gp3[k-8];
            end else begin: pass_8
                assign gg4[k] = gg3[k];
                assign gp4[k] = gp3[k];
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    assign arithmetic_result = p ^ carry;

    always @(*) begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b001: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b010: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = 64'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths cross a long arithmetic carry network and then the result-selection logic. The optimization targets carry depth and eliminates replication of the three arithmetic operations.",
  "rewrite": "Share one arithmetic datapath between addition and both subtraction directions. Use operand complementation and a subtraction carry-in, four-bit local carry lookahead, and a four-level parallel-prefix network over sixteen groups. Absorb the initial carry into bit zero's generate term. Retain the original case-based output selection.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Unmeasured estimate: approximately 10–25% lower maximum arrival than the 3.05 ns baseline. Explicit logarithmic group carry computation is intended to shorten the reported arithmetic paths. Actual timing and electrical compliance require the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The prefix network adds group propagate/generate logic, while sharing the arithmetic datapath removes separate add/subtract networks. Area is expected to remain below the 13098.437440 um^2 cap, but mapped area and zero electrical violations have not been verified.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, unsigned 64-bit input and output ports, 3-bit operation port, and all eight two-state operation behaviors. Arithmetic results are modulo 2^64; operation 010 computes b-a. Operation 111 returns zero. The unobservable internal c_out is omitted. No storage, latency, assumptions, external dependencies, or parameters are introduced. Equivalence follows from the carry equations but has not been checked with a mapped equivalence tool."
}
